name: Brute Force Login
description: 5 or more failed login attempts from a single IP within 5 minutes

name: Credential Stuffing
description: Single IP attempting failed logins across 3 or more distinct user accounts

name: Rate Limit Exceeded
description: Single IP exceeding 60 requests per minute

name: E-Commerce Scraping
description: Single IP querying more than 12 product catalog items in under 60 seconds

name: IDOR / BOLA Enumeration
description: Single client IP or user iterating over 5 or more distinct order or user identifiers

name: SQL Injection Pattern
description: Detection of SQL injection primitives (UNION SELECT, OR 1=1, SLEEP, syntax bypass) in path or query

name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
description: Detection of script injection, javascript: URI, or HTML payload handlers in URI parameters

name: Path Traversal & Command Injection
description: Detection of directory traversal (../, ..\) or shell execution tokens (;id, |whoami, /etc/passwd)

name: Malicious Scanner / Empty Bot
description: Known security vulnerability scanner (sqlmap, nikto, nmap, dirbuster, gobuster) or empty User-Agent

name: Sensitive Admin Endpoint Probe
description: Unauthorized probe for administrative or debug endpoints (/admin, /actuator, /.env, /.git, /wp-admin)

name: Application Error Spike
description: Sudden burst of 8 or more HTTP 4xx/5xx error responses for a single application in 1 minute

name: Spam Account Registration
owasp_tag: API6:2023 Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows
description: Single IP attempting 4 or more user registration requests within 5 minutes

name: Promo / Coupon Brute-Forcing
owasp_tag: API6:2023 Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows
description: Single IP testing 5 or more promotional codes or coupon validations in 5 minutes
